label: Professional services (consulting, agency, freelance)
default_stack: Static site with case studies, a scoping calculator and a booking link on GitHub Pages; proposals and invoices generated as documents in the repository; payment by bank transfer or Stripe invoice, set up by the owner.

questions.ask: What is the one fixed-scope offer you would sell first, and what does the client get?
questions.default: A fixed-price audit or starter package the idea implies, written up as one page.

questions.ask: Who signs the cheque (title, company size, industry)?
questions.default: Owner-operated businesses of 5-50 people in the industry the idea names.

questions.ask: What past work or credentials can be shown publicly?
questions.default: None assumed; the agent writes worked examples, clearly labelled as examples.

questions.ask: What day rate or project price do you want?
questions.default: The median of three published competitor prices, cited.

questions.ask: How many hours a week can you take calls and deliver?
questions.default: Ten hours a week of delivery, two of sales calls.

owner_setup.what: Decide whether to trade as yourself or register a company.
owner_setup.why: Liability and tax; an agent cannot sign registration forms.

owner_setup.what: Consider professional indemnity insurance for the offer.
owner_setup.why: Needs a card; the agent lists what is typical for the offer.

owner_setup.what: Create a booking link (Cal.com, Calendly) and paste the public URL into BUSINESS.md.
Open a separate business bank account.
owner_setup.why: Keeps the books clean; needs your ID.
